At today's "Surprise and Shine" event, Apple updated its official Design Resources website, adding product frame assets for iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro. Details are as follows.

iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro frame assets now available

Designers should be familiar with the Apple Design Resources website, which offers a collection of hardware and software assets for designers to use in their own work.

The assets provided on the website cover Figma, Sketch, Photoshop, PDF, PNG, and SVG materials for Apple's various platforms, products, and technologies, as well as fonts, SF Symbols, Apple's Icon Composer, and logos and badges for services such as Apple Health and Apple Wallet.

Following today's announcement of iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro, Apple has updated Photoshop and PNG assets for both new devices on the website.

The new assets include both unfolded and folded forms of the iPhone Duo, available in two color options; the iPhone 18 Pro features a smaller Dynamic Island.

To view the newly added frame assets and other materials on the Apple Design Resources website, please click here.
